text:
elaine_sales: Quick flag  Everfield Retail just escalated to their execs. CISO insists on customer-managed keys (BYO-KMS) and wants a firm throughput SLA for promotional spikes. Finance also requested a capex-style quote by EOD for procurement. Can infra + legal and pricing pick this up? cc @noah_solutions @ana_eng @linda_legal @mike_pricing :rotating_light:

noah_solutions: I can lead the infra side. Need their traffic shape: sustained vs short bursts, and expected p95/p99 targets. Do we have the export?

elaine_sales: Uploaded a summary to the invite. Peak ~11-13k req/min for 10-15min bursts during promos; baseline ~3-4k. p95 target <= 150ms, p99 <= 300ms.

ana_eng: Typo in participant name above ^^ but hi. Quick take: our dedicated cluster with warmed KV cache comfortably hits ~10k sustained. For 13k short bursts we have two pragmatic options: (A) small reserved burst pool sized for +3k qps, simpler for hard SLA, or (B) aggressive autoscale with warm standby lanes + prefix caching, cheaper overall but a bit riskier for hard SLA. Both need warm caches to meet p95.

linda_legal: From legal: CISO wants explicit key custody, audit log access, and an attestation of our rotation and compromise procedures. I can draft an addendum for BYO-KMS but need to know whether they'd accept cloud-KMS peering or insist on HSM/BYOHSM. Also need the list of KMS vendors they plan to use.

mike_pricing: Capex path is doable for a committed reserved pool. I can model a 12/24-month amortization and show OPEX-equivalent. Need delta $/month between reserved pool vs autoscale/burst to finalize numbers.

tori_prod: I'll run a quick risk note for the customer-facing SLA implications and list fallback policies (model variant fallback, regional fallback) we can offer if traffic overshoots.

noah_solutions: I'll post a 1-page ops note by 2pm with: assumptions, two capacity options (A+B), estimated latencies with warm cache, and rough cost delta. Will also call out HSM timeline: BYOHSM -> likely Private deployment or Dedicated with strong peering, ETA ~3-5 weeks for certs and approvals.

linda_legal: Drafting DPA addendum now. Will include required attestation fields: key ownership proof, rotation cadence, export controls, and audit log retention. Posting draft here by 4pm for review.

ops_bot: Ticket created: INC-50177 "Everfield Retail exec escalation: BYO-KMS + throughput SLA + capex request". Assigned to infra-team.

elaine_sales: Action items recap: (1) noah - ops note + two options by 2pm, (2) mike - capex model once delta is posted, (3) linda - DPA addendum draft by 4pm, (4) tori - SLA risk note, (5) ana - confirm cache-warm procedures. I'll schedule a 30-min bridge with their CISO & procurement at 5pm ET. Post artifacts here. :thumbsup:
